description: The coverage table for American Adventurer: for each job a camper needs done (land, rules, season, water, town run and so on), what the records hold, how many, from which source and as of when, the known gap, and who to ask next. Give job to keep the rows whose job contains that word. Read from https://davelalande.com/coverage.json; if that file is not published, it says so and invents nothing.

job.description: Optional: a word to match in the job name, like "water" or "season". Leave empty for every row.
